text:
神坛只在休息点出现，而且只在激活了信仰时才有献祭这个选项。献祭是把道具毁掉换经验值：祭品台只收满足这位神规矩的道具，每位神爱的东西不同，有按标签的，有按体积的，也有看带不带某条属性的。一件道具满足几条规矩就结算几次，换多少看它的稀有度乘上倍率；每座神坛能换的经验值有上限，超出的照献不再涨。

台上有东西时「献祭」亮起，先预览能加多少经验值、会不会升阶。献祭和特殊操作共享这个休息点上的一次机会：做过一样，这个神坛就关了。「返回」把台上的东西退回背包。神坛和歇脚是两份独立的机会，走开再回来还能用没用过的那份。不奉神也能在神坛前祷告，得一点经验值。

texts.en:
The Altar appears only at rest points, and the Offering option only when you have an active Faith. An Offering destroys items in exchange for XP: the offering table accepts only items that meet this god's rules. Each god favors different things: some rules go by Tag, some by size, and some check whether an item carries a certain stat. An item counts once for each rule it meets, and what it earns is its Rarity times a multiplier; each Altar gives only so much XP, and offering past that gives nothing more.

When something is on the table, "Offer" lights up and first previews how much XP you will gain and whether you will reach a new Rank. Offerings share this rest point's single chance with special rites: do either one and this Altar closes. "Back" returns everything on the table to your pack. The Altar and resting are two separate chances; walk away and come back, and you can still use whichever one you haven't used. Even without a god you can pray at the Altar for a little XP.
